saved.personalLinks: Guests see this design with their own personalized invitation content.
saved.draftHelp: Saving updates the draft only. Publish to update the design shown on guest invitation links.
saved.publishSuccess: The invitation design and guest invitations have been published.
saved.publishFailed: Couldn't publish the invitation. Please try again.
saved.emptyDescription: Choose a template in Studio, make your edits, then select “Save & apply” to use it for guest invitation links.

errors.generic: Couldn't complete the request. Please try again.
errors.channelNotConfigured: This delivery channel isn't configured. Contact an administrator.
errors.senderNotFound: SpeedSMS didn't recognize the configured sender. Contact an administrator; don't change delivery settings yourself.
errors.insufficientBalance: The SpeedSMS account has insufficient balance.
errors.conflict: The data changed elsewhere. Load the latest version and confirm before overwriting.
errors.invalidRequest: The server rejected the content or recipient list. Check plain-text content, contact details, the 5,000-recipient limit, and SMS length.
errors.notFound: The draft, guest, or group could not be found. Reload the data.

validation.subject: Enter a one-line email subject of up to 200 characters.
validation.emailLength: Email content must be no more than 10,000 characters.
validation.emailCopyRules: Email content must be plain invitation copy; don't enter links, QR references, HTML, or placeholder markers.
validation.smsLength: SMS content must be no more than 10,000 characters.
validation.smsCopyRules: SMS content must be plain invitation copy; don't enter links, QR references, HTML, or placeholder markers.

uncertainSend: We couldn't confirm whether the request reached the server. You can safely retry the exact request with the same idempotency key.
confirmSend: Send {{channels}} invitations to {{details}}? The server will perform the final permission, contact, and limit checks.
keepEditsOnNewVersion: Your edits are kept. Select Save to try writing them to the latest version.
composeDescription: Email and SMS use separate content. The server provides personalized links; they aren't stored in the browser.
noDraft: There is no draft yet. Generate one with AI or start writing below.
guestViewRequired: You can send invitations, but need GUEST_VIEW access to choose recipients, preview, and track delivery.
aiInstructionsPlaceholder: For example: warm, concise, and elegant…
replaceDraftConfirm: Generating new AI content will replace the saved server draft. Unsaved edits will be lost. Continue?
emailContentPlaceholder: Enter plain invitation copy. The system adds the greeting, event details, and RSVP button.
smsContentPlaceholder: For example: Please join our wedding celebration.
smsContentHelp: Invitation copy uses up to 40 characters and may be shortened further to fit the guest name and RSVP link. Preview shows the complete message to be sent, up to 201 characters.
serverHasVersion: The server has version {{version}}. Your current edits are preserved. Choose how to proceed before saving.
keepEditsUseLatest: Keep edits and confirm against the latest version
previewDescription: Preview the actual personalized HTML email. It uses the same template as the sent email.
saveBeforePreview: Save the draft before previewing or sending to keep the content consistent.
testEmailConfirm: Send a test email to the email address of your signed-in account? This won't go to guests.
sendTestToMyEmail: Send a test to my email
saveBeforeTest: Save the content before sending a test.
testAccepted: The server accepted the test request for your account.
sendDescription: Choose all guests or a specific group, select your channels, and send your invitations in one action.
selectionAcrossPages: Selections across pages are kept for this session.
missingContacts: {{count}} selected guests are missing contact details for the chosen channels. The server performs the final validation.
maxRecipients: Each send supports up to 5,000 guests.
uncertainSendDetails: The previous request wasn't confirmed. Retrying uses the same body and idempotency key to avoid duplicate batches.
publishBeforeSend: Publish the invitation design before sending links.
sendNotAccepted: {{error}} The send wasn't accepted. Check the configuration, then start a new attempt.
deliveryDisclaimer: “Sent” means the provider accepted the request; it doesn't confirm that an email reached an inbox or an SMS reached a phone.

picker.description: Explore a template demo, or edit and apply it to your wedding.

removeMissingContacts: Deselect {{count}} guests with missing contact details
